<h1>Course and form privacy</h1>
<p>The public course does not require GitHub sign-in. Course progress stays in your browser, while the separate course entry form is collected through University of Illinois Forms.</p>
<div class="lesson-meta">
<span>No learner account required</span>

::: {.lesson-main}

## Two separate services

The Accelerometer Learning Course is a public GitHub Pages website. The [LA PASSSTA Lab course entry form](https://forms.illinois.edu/sec/457778289) is hosted separately by University of Illinois Forms. Opening or submitting that form sends the information you enter to the Illinois Forms service; the course website does not receive or copy those answers.

After a successful form submission, Illinois Forms may return you to `intake.html?surveyComplete=1`. The course then saves only a browser-local marker indicating that the entry step was completed and opens the requested course page (or Module 1). The marker contains a completion flag and timestamp, not the form responses.

The return link is a convenience for the learner, not secure proof that a form was submitted. Anyone with access to the course URL can bypass the browser-local marker. The form supports course-entry data collection; it is not access control, enrollment verification, or a security boundary.

## Information kept in your browser

As you use the course, the website may store the following in your browser's local or session storage so the interactive pathway works on that device and browser profile:

- the course-entry completion marker;
- module progress and completion choices;
- quiz selections and locally calculated results;
- module and final feedback entered in the course pages; and
- a locally generated, non-verifiable certificate record if you complete the pathway.

These browser records are not uploaded to the former course database. They are not UIUC grades, academic records, enrollment records, or an official UIUC credential. Someone who can use the same browser profile may be able to inspect them. Clearing site data or using another device or browser can remove or hide them, and the course team cannot restore them.

## Illinois Forms data

The form page describes the fields it collects and any applicable notice, access, retention, or contact information. Enter only your own information. Do not enter participant or patient names, health information, raw study data, confidential information, or other sensitive data unless the Illinois Form explicitly requests it under an approved process.

Because the form is maintained outside this static course website, requests about a submitted response must be directed to the form contact or the course steward through the [LA PASSSTA Lab website](https://publish.illinois.edu/lapassstalab/).

## Former synchronized course records

Earlier versions of the course supported optional GitHub authentication and a separate Supabase course-data service. The public learner pages no longer load that login or send new progress, quiz, feedback, or certificate events to that service. The legacy backend and restricted administrator tools remain separate from the learner website so authorized staff can manage any records that were previously collected.

If you previously created a synchronized course record and need access, correction, export, or deletion assistance, contact the course steward through the [LA PASSSTA Lab website](https://publish.illinois.edu/lapassstalab/). Do not place personal course data in a public GitHub Issue.

## Hosting and external links

GitHub hosts the public course pages and [states that it logs and stores a visitor's IP address for security purposes](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/what-is-github-pages#data-collection). Illinois Forms, linked documentation, videos, and other external services have their own privacy and security practices.

The optional GitHub Issue links are for public corrections and accessibility reports. Anything you type and submit in an issue is public; the course never copies browser-local feedback into an issue automatically.
